title: Cross-Entropy Loss
hint: log_probs = logits - logsumexp(logits, dim=-1, keepdim=True). Loss = -log_probs[arange(B), targets].mean(). Subtract max for stability (logsumexp handles this).

description.text: Implement cross-entropy loss for multi-class classification from logits. For each row, CE = -log(exp(logits[y]) / sum_c exp(logits[c])). Return the mean over the batch.

examples.output: Scalar loss ≈ negative mean of log-softmax at correct class (use log-sum-exp for stability).
examples.explanation: Apply the log-sum-exp trick so large logits do not overflow.

constraints: Return a scalar tensor (mean over batch).
Do not use F.cross_entropy or nn.CrossEntropyLoss.
